# rustinion_status_page (Resource)

Manages the tenant's one public status page (there is exactly one per tenant — see this resource's own doc comment for how that singleton shape is modeled). See status_pages.rs in the main repo for uptime computation and incident lifecycle; this resource only manages the page's own slug/title/components. Manual incidents are managed by the separate rustinion_status_page_incident resource, since a page has many incidents rather than the singleton shape this resource has.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) 3-63 lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens; must be unique across every tenant (it's the public page's own URL segment).
- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `component` (Block List) One status page component, in display order. Each must reference a synthetic check already belonging to this tenant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--component))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned status page ID.

<a id="nestedblock--component"></a>
### Nested Schema for `component`

Required:

- `display_name` (String)
- `synthetic_check_id` (String) ID of the synthetic check this component's uptime is derived from.
